// GREEN fixture for `no-raw-ci-verdict` — the lint MUST admit this.
// Completion is reported through the SANCTIONED reporter abstraction: the reporter (the one site that
// verifies the runner's real guest exit code) owns the verdict encoding + the typed delivery. This
// caller hands the reporter the runner's report and never constructs `SignalPayload::CiJobDone` or
// calls `signal_typed` itself — so no forged verdict can originate here.
pub fn report_completion(
    reporter: &dyn TerminalReporter,
    run: &RunId,
    idem_token: &str,
    report: &TerminalReport,
) -> Result<SignalOutcome, ExecutorError> {
    // The reporter derives `passed` from the verified guest exit code and mints the verdict itself.
    reporter.report_done(run, idem_token, report)
}
